7. Cod. Vaticanus 212. — Paper, cm. 42 × 16.5, ff. 152. Two scribes wrote:
first hand, 14th c., f. 1-105; second hand, 14th or early 15th c.,
f. 106-152. — F. 1, is read: Book of Laudinius knight of Jerusalem bought in Crete.

summary.headline: Vaticanus 212: Astrological Works
summary.text: Catalog entry for Vaticanus 212, a 152-folio paper manuscript with fourteenth- and early fifteenth-century hands. Its contents include works by Claudius Ptolemy, John Chrysostom, John the Grammarian, and Isaac Argyros on astrology, lunar latitude, planetary hypotheses, star calculations, astrolabes, geometry, and related tables and notes.
